svg.title: Create Life mission statement
svg.desc: Original task-flow layout and wiring, styled for Moti-Pulse. Start; Choose “Life Purpose”; Type in Screen; Type in Life Mission?; Choose “Type” Button; Life Mission Screen; Choose “Choose” Button; Change Theme?; Category Screen; Choose Categories from list; Swipe to change to others statement; Choose “Theme” Button; Themes Screens; Select a Theme; End; Choose “My Mission” section; Full Screen.
